analytical_capability: Broad cross-country monthly central-bank policy-rate repository capability for monetary-policy stance and financial-condition analysis.
expected_observations: 4900-4968 provider-valued or explicit-missing monthly scalar cells; all candidate cells must reconcile.

expected_provider_exclusions.whole_series_absence: 0 expected for selected countries after preflight; explicit missing periods may occur inside valid series.

expected_acquisition_and_transport_risks: BIS SDMX API may reject overly broad keys or large requests.
Provider may return StructureSpecificData with sparse country histories.
BIS may use ISO2-like area codes requiring source-specific territory reconciliation.
Header prepared timestamps may be provider-generation timestamps rather than release vintages.
expected_implementation_friction: Moderate: existing TASK-057 parser is bounded to US/JP and must be scaled source-specifically without creating generic BIS/SDMX infrastructure; PostgreSQL load must preserve full series-key attributes and idempotence.

expected_postgresql_growth.facts: about 4968 minus sparse explicit missing already loaded as facts
expected_postgresql_growth.source_rows: 1 new canonical BIS public SDMX source if none exists

expected_architectural_compatibility: Existing monthly scalar substrate should be compatible because each complete BIS series key maps to a stable source-scoped indicator identity plus attribute set; no multidimensional schema expected for WS_CBPOL.
structural_assumptions_pressure_tested: BIS source identity can be separated from BIS WS_CBPOL dataset identity and campaign run identity.
BIS ISO2 reference areas can reconcile to existing country territory identities without canonical expansion for selected countries.
The complete WS_CBPOL series key M.<REF_AREA> can be represented without semantic loss as a source-scoped indicator identity plus attributes for policy-rate metadata.
Monthly period and percent unit identities prevent collisions across future BIS datasets.
Absent months inside valid BIS series can be represented as explicit missing facts only when the candidate grid makes them expected.
Same-run and same-dataset reruns update provenance without duplicate source/dataset/fact rows.
